component.name: Crosspoint
component.summary: Audio mixer with routing matrix on PipeWire

description.p: Crosspoint is an audio mixer for Linux. Eight input strips are routed to eight buses through a crosspoint matrix. Every input reaches the hardware buses as its raw signal; the three virtual outputs add a noise gate and echo cancellation that removes the system sound your speakers feed back into the microphone. Recording and VBAN streaming over the local network are built in.
Devices and routing are handled by PipeWire; the mixer runs as a JACK client, so any PipeWire or JACK application can feed and record it.
